mapper.select: SELECT user_code, nickname, name, profile_key, cover_image_key FROM users u WHERE user_code = #{userCode}

SELECT user_code, nickname, name, email, birth, password, phone, profile_key
FROM users WHERE user_code = #{userCode}
SELECT path FROM image WHERE image_code = #{imageCode}

SELECT (SELECT count(store_code) FROM store WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS greenfireCount, (SELECT count(challenge_part_code) FROM challenge_part WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS challengeCount, (SELECT count(post_code) FROM post WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS feedCount, (SELECT count(target_user) FROM user_follows WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS friendCount

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ch.challenge_code as challengeCode, ch.challenge_title as challengeTitle, ch.challenge_content, ch.thumbnail_url as thumbnail, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ch.created_at) AS rn FROM challenge_part cp LEFT JOIN challenge ch ON cp.challenge_code = ch.challenge_code WHERE cp.user_code = #{userCode} ) t WHERE t.rn <= 3
SELECT COUNT(challenge_part_code) FROM challenge_part WHERE user_code = #{userCode}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_follows WHERE user_code = #{userCode} AND target_user = #{targetUser}
mapper.select: SELECT challenge_code as challengeCode, challenge_title as challengeTitle, thumbnail_url as thumbnailUrl, host_user as hostUser FROM challenge WHERE host_user = #{userCode}

SELECT u.user_code as userCode, u.nickname as nickname, u.profile_image as profileImage, (followings.user_code IS NOT NULL) AS isFollowing, (followers.user_code IS NOT NULL) AS isFollower FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_follows followings ON followings.target_user = u.user_code AND followings.user_code = #{currentUserCode} LEFT JOIN user_follows followers ON followers.user_code = u.user_code AND followers.target_user = #{currentUserCode} WHERE followings.user_code IS NOT NULL OR followers.user_code IS NOT NULL

SELECT u.user_code AS userCode, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_key AS profileKey, u.cover_image_key AS coverKey, COALESCE(u.total_spark, 0) AS totalSpark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follows WHERE target_user = u.user_code) AS followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follows WHERE user_code = u.user_code) AS followingCount,
EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_follows WHERE user_code = #{viewerCode}::uuid AND target_user = u.user_code )
FALSE AS isFollowing FROM users u WHERE u.user_code = #{targetCode}::uuid
